title: Countable products in the derived category
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-derived-limit-products-core, the derived category has countable products.

proof.text: For a countable discrete diagram F, take C j = Q.objPreimage (F.obj j). The termwise-product theorem proves that Q.mapCone (limit.cone (Discrete.functor C)) is limiting. Package this specific cone as a HasLimit for Discrete.functor C ⋙ Q and transport along the natural isomorphism with components Q.objObjPreimageIso (F.obj j). Package the resulting HasLimit instances as HasCountableProducts.

proof_origin.note: A genuine reduction using the specific termwise product cone, essential surjectivity of Q and transport along a natural isomorphism; one hole closed and one strictly intermediate hole added.
